UPDATED PAYMENTS TERMS

We’re updating our Payments Terms of Service
[https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/2856?c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMzkzMzMxMTg2OTg0&euid=0c819b7f-e4b8-44db-d629-8f9c6619a7f2]
to support our evolving business and new features, and to address upcoming laws and regulations.

The updated Payments Terms will go into effect for existing users on September 8, 2025.

We encourage you to review the updated Payments Terms in full and download a copy
[https://www.airbnb.com/d/termsofserviceupdate?c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMzkzMzMxMTg2OTg0&euid=0c819b7f-e4b8-44db-d629-8f9c6619a7f2]
for your records. We’ve also provided an overview of how our Payments Terms are changing in our Help
Center
[https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/3944?c=.pi80.pkb21uaS8xLzMwMzkzMzMxMTg2OTg0&euid=0c819b7f-e4b8-44db-d629-8f9c6619a7f2].

If you disagree with the updated Payments Terms, you may terminate your agreement with Airbnb at any
time by deleting your account at no cost or penalty to you. Unless you delete your account, you will
be deemed to have accepted the updated Payment Terms.

If you have any questions or encounter any difficulties during this process, please email\support69@test.org [info70@demo.co.uk] for assistance.
Thank you for being a valued member of our community.
